title: Daande e nder sanɗaaji ɓooyɗi
intro: E nder nelaa6e Alla adan6e, ina woodi gooto mo innde mum ina jalba ko juuti kono ina jogii maanaa e nder Qur’aana. Oo neɗɗo wuuri ko ɓooyi hade annabaaɓe mawɓe heewɓe neldeede, omo anndiraa goonga e muñal mo ustataako. Daartol maɓɓe ina juuti kono ndonu maɓɓe ina duumii e binndol duumingol. Hol ooɗoo ruuhu tedduɗo?
clues: Miɗo jeyaa e nelaaɓe adanɓe, ciftinaaɓe seeɗa kono ina njogii maanaa e nder Quraan.
Jikku am ina siforee darnde tiiɗnde e goonga nde ustataako.
Mi siftortenoo ko e deftere Alla e nder hoyɓe dariiɓe e muñooɓe.
Ko aayeeji seeɗa tan e nder Quraan ina kaala daartol am.
Alla teddinii kam e mbaadi ndi miin tan jogii, ndi renndaani e annabaaɓe woɗɓe.
Mi ummiima e darnde toownde, teddungal gootal e nder Quraana.

trial.label: Sifaa Momen
options: Mi umminaama e darnde toownde ko Alla
Mi mahi laana mawka ngam hisnugo yimɓe am
Banndiraaɓe am mberlii kam e nder ɓuuɓri
Mi majjii gite am e sunaare e ɓiɗɗo am
trial.answer: Mi umminaama e darnde toownde ko Alla

outcome.label: Teddungal Alla
options: Staasiyoŋ toowɗo mo nanndaani e goɗɗo
Laamu teddeendi ndi alaa ɗo haaɗi
outcome.answer: Staasiyoŋ toowɗo mo nanndaani e goɗɗo

arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient. (21:85)
